items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Joe Saunders and the other boy handled all the instruments, bandstand and stuff.

ctx.x: We get dressed right in the bus travelling. The bus get there, we just put on the ties and (inaudible).
They had two -- Joe Saunders and the other boy handled all the instruments, bandstand and stuff.
They would set up the bandstand while we be getting dressed. We'd walk right out. They'd take all the instruments and set them up on the stands,
